fixes: Per-socket persistent exact-read and frame buffers; per-socket FIFO retains every coalesced frame.
Context-managed login/char sockets remove framing state on success and all exceptions.
Connect failures close map socket; close shuts down and joins reader; failed/unstarted readers are safe; non-stopping readers retain identity and block reuse.
Wire actor ID at offset 5 indexes actors and matches vanish; character ID at offset 9 is separately retained.
Only the receive reader dispatches; drain discards already-dispatched queue observations.
Absolute monotonic connection deadline spans login, char, map, TCP setup and handshake writes; default 35s budget; cleared after connect.
Receive EOF/framing/socket failures and dispatch failures are retained for harness health checks; map EOF cannot be accepted as handshake success.
Unsupported character creation fails closed with NotImplementedError before any wire write.
CLI requires a private explicit JSON account manifest; no reusable credential defaults or credential command-line flags.

coordination_api.connect: connect(*, deadline: float | None = None) -> BotClient; deadline is absolute time.monotonic(); None uses a 35-second total budget.
coordination_api.receive_health: rx_error: Exception | None (None on intentional close); running and connected_map clear on reader failure.
coordination_api.dispatch_health: dispatch_errors: list[tuple[int, str]]; nonempty means unhealthy even if reader remains alive.
coordination_api.retry: close must finish reader shutdown/join before connect resets state; stuck reader raises RuntimeError and remains referenced. Join capped at 2 seconds and remaining connection budget.
coordination_api.actor_identity: actors[wire_id]["gid"] == wire_id; ["char_id"] holds separate character ID; self.gid remains selected character ID.
coordination_api.creation: create_flag retained; missing character + create_flag=True reaches _create_char and fails closed; provision existing characters separately.
coordination_api.cli_manifest: python client.py /private/path/account.json; one object with user/password, optional char_name/login_ip/login_port; owner-only regular file, no leaf symlinks.
